header.title: SysOps 24/7
header.subtitle: Know it's down before your customers do.
header.description: Modern systems operations monitoring from TenthMatrix. SysOps 24/7 watches your endpoints, certificates and DNS on a tight interval — then tells the right person the moment something breaks, with AI incident summaries so responders know where to look first.

intro.title: Replace the five tools you're duct-taping together
intro.body: SysOps 24/7 is one control plane for uptime, latency, certificates and alerting — self-hosted when you want the data to stay on your infrastructure. Probe HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, ICMP, DNS and SSL expiry; route Slack, email, webhook and Telegram alerts with de-duplication; publish a public status page without exposing IPs or internals.

items.title: Six monitor types
items.text: HTTP, HTTPS, TCP, ICMP, DNS and SSL-expiry checks — one control plane instead of five tools.

items.title: Alerts that reach a human
items.text: Slack, email, webhooks and Telegram, with de-duplication — so one outage isn't fifty pings.

items.title: AI incident summaries
items.text: Every alert arrives with a plain-English explanation of what likely broke, and where to look first.

items.title: Latency you can act on
items.text: p50/p95 response times per endpoint — not just a binary up/down flag.

items.title: Group by project
items.text: Create a project per app or team. Every monitor lives in one, so dashboards and status pages stay organised as you grow.

items.title: Add your endpoints
items.text: Point SysOps 24/7 at a URL, host or cluster. It starts probing on your interval within seconds — no agent or sidecar to install.

items.title: Publish a status page
items.text: Flip one switch to share a public page grouped by project. Customers see what's up; they never see your internals.

agents.title: Where AI agents fit in ops
agents.intro: Monitoring without context burns responders. SysOps 24/7 pairs classic probes with AI so on-call gets a usable brief — and connects cleanly to TenthMatrix's agent stack when you want automated triage or remediation with human approval.

items.title: AI incident summaries
items.text: Plain-English explanation of what likely broke and where to look first — included on paid plans with monthly summary quotas.

items.title: Fast check intervals
items.text: From free 30-minute checks to Starter 30-second and Pro 10-second probes — know it's down before tickets pile up.

items.title: Multi-tenant by design
items.text: Every query is scoped to an org. Teams share an instance without sharing data.

items.title: Trusted status pages
items.text: Group domains by project, publish on your own domain, and keep targets, IPs and check config private.

items.title: Own your data
items.text: Self-host so monitoring data never leaves your infrastructure — or run the managed path from sysops247.com.

items.title: Works with TenthMatrix agents
items.text: Pair with Jobshout and the rest of the Tools stack when you want AI agents to investigate alerts and stop for approval before changes.

features.title: Everything a modern ops stack needs

items.title: Endpoint & protocol coverage
items.text: Watch APIs, apps, CDNs and legacy hosts with HTTP/S, TCP, ICMP, DNS and certificate expiry in one place.

items.title: De-duplicated alerting
items.text: Route to Slack, email, webhooks and Telegram without turning a single outage into a storm of notifications.

items.title: Public status without exposure
items.text: Customers see operational / down by friendly name. Targets, IPs and check config stay private.

items.title: Pricing that scales
items.text: Free tier to kick the tyres, Starter and Pro subscriptions, or pay-as-you-go monitor-hours with no lock-in.

items.title: Projects as the unit of organisation
items.text: Dashboards, alerts and status pages stay coherent as you add apps and teams.

items.title: No YAML archaeology
items.text: No agents, no sidecars — add a URL and start probing within seconds.
